entities.summary: Woodward Maurice "Tex" Ritter was an American country music singer and actor. He was the patriarch of the Ritter acting family. He is a member of the Country Music Hall of Fame. Tex Ritter was a composers & musicians from Murvaul (1905-01-12, Murvaul–1974-01-02). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
